✨ What's new
📏Build toolsDrag to build lines, filled boxes or hollow walls up to 12 layers high. Erase, paint and copy blocks by swiping. Mirror builds both halves at once. Undo and redo everything.
🧱New pieces & materialsSteel, brick, ice, rubber, crystal and obsidian, plus girders, beams, slabs, half blocks, ridges and drums. Each one feels different: ice slides, rubber bounces, crystal shatters.
💥30 new weaponsRailgun, drill, wrecking ball, sticky bombs, remote C4, carpet bomber, lightning, tidal wave, volcano, laser satellite, antimatter… and a piano. Filter them by type above the tray.
🎯Smoother playTap 🎯 to frame your build. Shockwave rings and scorch marks on every blast. Reduce motion in the 🪙 menu.
